answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable randomness is unavailable when an agent must commit; the later reveal binds the response to that challenge. This blocks advance computation and reusable offline answer farms, including swarms of pseudonymous agents, while not treating randomness as identity: admission controls still matter. A sonnet, haven, or opal label is merely data, never a source of trust.
